nh15e01.title: Aries arrives two hours early
nh15e01.caption: Two hours early, tinsel on everyone, zero chill. Then Aries slowed down for the part that matters: the hello. Who in your family always shows up way too early?

nh15e02.title: Taurus gives the buffet tour
nh15e02.caption: Taurus gave a full museum tour of the buffet, then did the unthinkable: handed over the last slice of pie. From a Taurus, that's a love letter. Who gets your last bite?

nh15e03.title: Gemini wrote three family guides
nh15e03.caption: Guide A: Dad loves sports. Guide B: never mention sports. Guide C: Dad is a cat person. Dad just said come in, it's cold. Gemini, how many drafts are you on?

nh15e04.title: Cancer already has a stocking
nh15e04.caption: Cancer paced the porch rehearsing every worst case. Mom had already stitched a stocking with the date's name on it. Tag the Cancer who worries before every hello.
